verdict.rationale: NerdGraph (docs-2, docs-20) is a GraphQL API that can 'configure some New Relic features,' and NRQL-based alerts (docs-21/25) can be set up programmatically, implying API-driven provisioning of alerts and dashboards. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents a Terraform provider, JSON dashboard schema, or dedicated dashboards/alerts-as-code workflow — the newrelic-cli (gh-1/gh-3) only covers entity search/tagging/deployment markers, not dashboard or alert definitions. Missing for 10: explicit Terraform provider documentation, JSON dashboard-as-code schema/import-export tooling, and CLI/API examples specifically for repeatable alert/dashboard provisioning.
